reason: I might throw the free 30 receipts at it to see what it does, but I'm not moving my staff and my work groups onto a little Telegram bot I've never heard of and paying monthly for it. The mess annoys me, but I only dig into it when something smells wrong, so it's not burning enough to make me pay now.
objection: Will this bot still be running in a year? If I train my staff to send everything through it, give it access to my Google, and then it disappears or the price jumps, I'm back to square one and I've got a half-filled sheet nobody maintains.
would_change_my_mind: Another villa operator in Bali telling me they've used it for six months with their staff in the group and it hasn't missed receipts or broken. That, plus seeing it catch a real duplicate or wrong total in my own groups during the free trial.
